newsitem.title: USA: MIDAMERICAN ENERGY CFO LINDNER TO RETIRE.
newsitem.headline: MIDAMERICAN ENERGY CFO LINDNER TO RETIRE.

text.p: MidAmerican Energy Holding Co said Monday its chief financial officer, Phil Lindner, plans to retire when he reaches age 55 in 1998.
Alan Wells, vice-president of corporate development, has been named to fill the chief financial officer position, effective November 1, the utility said.
The two will work together to insure a smooth trnasition of the CFO duties, the company said.
Lindner joined the company in 1989 as vice-president for finance.
MidAmerican Energy shares were unchanged Monday at 17.
